meta.title: Bule Azul: order your coffee ahead and skip the queue
meta.description: Order through the Bule Azul app and pick up your coffee at the counter, no queue.

hero.title: Your coffee at the rigth time, no queue.
hero.lead: Order through the Bule Azul app, pick a pickup time and swing by the counter: your coffee comes out hot, in the size and with the milk you asked for.

step1.title: Pick from the menu
step1.text: Espresso, fresh drip, cappuccino and over 30 more drinks, with plant-based milk at no extra charge.

step2.title: Pay in the app
step2.text: Pix or card. Your order joins the barista's queue as soon as the payment is confirmed.

step3.title: Skip the queue
step3.text: We let you know when it is ready. Just stop by the counter, say your name and go.

tip.title: Barista tip
tip.text: Drip coffee tastes best with water between 90 °C and 96 °C (194 to 205 °F): switch the kettle off as soon as it boils and wait a minute before pouring. Boiling water scorches the grounds and turns the drink bitter. Use two tablespoons of grounds for every cup.

club.title: Bule Club
club.perk2: 10% off the rest of the menu
club.perk3: Seasonal beans at home every month

q1.question: Can I schedule my pickup?
q1.answer: Yes. Choose the time when you place the order and it will be ready right when you said.

q2.question: Is there a lactose-free option?
q2.answer: Yes: lactose-free, oat or almond milk, at no extra charge.

q3.question: Do you deliver?
q3.answer: We deliver within 3 km of the counter, from 7 am to 7 pm, with your coffee in a thermal pack.

footer.feedback: Spotted something odd? Tell us with the feedback button in the corner of the screen.
footer.fine: Demo site: Bule Azul is a fictional product.
